established_unconditionally.claim: rho=4 / T=18 is structurally impossible for an order-3 operator
established_unconditionally.reason: A Fuchsian operator of order n governs a rank-n local system. order(L3)=3, so any sub-VHS it governs has rank 3, not 18. T=18 would require order 18.

This independently corroborates E-009 Lead 1 (group is Γ₀(7)+, not Γ₀(7), which has ν₂=0). Inferred from exponent data + standard Fuchsian theory — NOT a rigorous identification.
